name: vscode-topoviewer
description: VS Code workspace host for TopoViewer Studio.

topoviewer.preview.defaultStylesheet.description: Default stylesheet filename to pair with a TopoViewer topology YAML file.

topoviewer.preview.defaultMapper.description: Default mapper filename to pair with TopoViewer topology and stylesheet YAML files.

topoviewer.preview.defaultTopology.description: Default topology filename to pair with a TopoViewer stylesheet YAML file.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/require-node24.mjs && npm --workspace topoviewer run build:lib && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:extension: npm --workspace topoviewer-studio run build:contracts && node scripts/build-extension.mjs
scripts.vscode:harness: node ../../scripts/require-node24.mjs && node ../../scripts/check-port-free.mjs "Browser harness" 127.0.0.1 5174 && npm --workspace topoviewer run build:lib && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort --config vite.harness.config.ts
scripts.vscode:harness:build: node ../../scripts/require-node24.mjs && npm --workspace topoviewer run build:lib && vite build --config vite.harness.config.ts
scripts.vscode:studio-host: node ../../scripts/require-node24.mjs && npm --workspace topoviewer run build:lib && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5176 --strictPort --config vite.studio-host.config.ts
scripts.test:extension: npm run build && xvfb-run -a node scripts/run-extension-tests.mjs
scripts.test:studio-host:gate: npm run build && npm run check:studio-webview && npm run test:unit && npm run test:studio-host && npm run test:extension
scripts.test:vscode-harness: node ../../scripts/require-node24.mjs && npm --workspace topoviewer run build:lib && playwright test --config playwright.config.js
